_comment: Single source of truth for the WhatsApp groups the bot advertises in. The seven workspace/cron/*-promo/targets.json files are GENERATED from this file by workspace/bin/make-promo-targets; CI fails if they drift, so edit here and regenerate. Group names live here because the gateway only learns a name from WhatsApp itself and shows most of these groups blank, and names must NOT be written into the gateway's session database (doing so took the bot down on 2026-10-14). Membership cannot be listed via the gateway: new groups are discovered by hand from the WhatsApp sender-key store (credentials/whatsapp/default/sender-key-<jid>...) and recorded here. status gates generation -- only 'active' groups are advertised to, while 'promos' is kept even for a paused group so resuming it needs only a status flip. activity sets the daily-ad band (see defaults.bands); daily_cap overrides the band outright. Print the full list with workspace/bin/list-groups.

borehole-drilling.comment: GENERATED from workspace/cron/membership.json by workspace/bin/make-promo-targets -- do not hand-edit. Add or remove a group by editing its 'promos' list in membership.json and regenerating (CI fails if this file drifts). Only groups with status 'active' reach this list, which is why admin-only, not-a-member and on-hold groups are absent. Invite links are NOT reliably resolvable on this gateway, so membership.json records group JIDs.
borehole-drilling.weekly_comment: Groups posted to only on specific weekdays instead of daily (the cron still runs every day; these are skipped on other days). Weekdays may be names (mon, tue, wed, thu, fri, sat, sun) or ints (Mon=0 .. Sun=6). Set per group under 'weekly' in membership.json.
